The lint strips comments and string literals (a position-preserving scanner) before the agent(, model:/effort: and table-assignment scans, and allows exactly the skeleton's RUN.tier adoption form: `RUN.tier = <member chain> || null`, with no quoted literal — `RUN.tier = 'planner'` and the TIER/ROLE/OVERRIDE assignments stay rejected. Two new lint tests run the spec's own skeletons (topics/story-script.md, topics/wave-script.md) through workflow_problems and expect no problems, and a third asserts the toys raise no 'tier settings are the roster's' problem.

The call scan allows whitespace before the parenthesis, and every workflow( call whose first argument is not one complete quoted literal (concatenation, interpolation, bare name) is reported as non-literal — the argument is read from the original body at the scanner's offset. The backtick test is now a forbidden edge: wave calling `vsdd-factory:release` with backticks is rejected.
